input_provenance_requirement: Atlas's original archive/member receipt supplies the local path; root retains that original member binding. The checker additionally requires the fixed raw byte count/SHA and a stable before/after stat.
two_phases_in_one_invocation: Read/decode the original UTF-8 snapshot once while hashing the same bytes; verify raw identity and the original sorted-canonical-JSON context_signature using iterencode. Extract actual shape, resolution/facet and header-candidate indexes.

Release the full parsed descriptor and compare the extracted identity map to existing same_bytes.jsonl and only_P1_reachable.jsonl. Verify their original hashes from pinned SUMMARY.json; never read original P1/P3 graphs or provider files.

contents: actual top-level keys and modules/files/resolutions counts
resolution prefix counts and physical-file suffix counts
actual associated facet count and unassociated companion count
observed structure-field counts and exact header-candidate count
output_files.interpretation: Describes original fixed snapshot metadata. It is not a current P2 filesystem or full import-graph acceptance.
Every emitted companion is an existing files entry; no required/missing facet is invented from an absent header.
Actual companion-suffix records not safely associated with a resolutions base. Preserve for targeted follow-up, not silent omission.

Records observed keys among actual_modules/module_headers/header(s)/moduleData/is_module/isModule/direct_imports/parts/facet(s)/importgraph spellings. Absence in this finite key set is not a universal claim that no differently encoded graph exists.
Exact useful header-shaped records retained for review; existence alone is not accepted compiled-header provenance or completeness.
Do not substitute a conflicting artifact based only on name, source pin or shared checkout.
No associated row was recoverable from this descriptor. This is not physical P2 absence.

contents: actual elapsed time and peak RSS

output_files.contents: Every generated preceding file's exact bytes and SHA; no self-reference.

boundaries: This prepared checker is not a new proof or a replacement original external qualifier.
It never calls the consumer helper's physical verify() and never opens paths taken from files/resolutions as local provider files.
It does not assert all standard modules/facets or compiled headers are present merely from size, native count or candidate field names.
Original descriptor coverage is kept distinct from current P2 placement/stat and the final Omitted merged environment.
No automatic re-run on failure and no ref updates; only immutable Git blobs are created for this preparation.
